Inscriptions of "Heng Ke Dali", "Shi Zeng" and "Anyang Shi room" seal.　　The year "Nonsu" is the eleventh year of the Republic of China (1922).　　The drawing of the Buddha's hand fruit is accurate in shape and realistic in form. Chen Shizeng's cultural cultivation in poetic and literary allusions is quite profound, and the inscription in this picture is from Gong Zizhen's "Luhua" of the Qing dynasty, the content of which involves many Buddhist allusions. The combination of the picture and the text makes the simple picture more profound. In his later years, Chen Shizeng received a piece of record stone from the Tang Dynasty unearthed in Anyang, and named his study "Anyang Stone Room" out of his love for jinshi calligraphy.
